verdict.rationale: An employer tax-and-wage portal like EAMS could plausibly offer event-triggered automation such as automatic payments or rule-based alerts, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes manual tasks: filing reports online or by mail, appeals, penalty waivers and account setup. Probes found no API, OpenAPI spec or machine-readable docs, and the authenticated portal could not be inspected, so there is no evidence of user-defined rules or event-triggered actions.
